title: Theme River Generator
confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all data?
tip1: Theme river is suitable for visualizing evolution of multiple categories
tip2: Each data point requires date, value and series name
detailed_description: The Theme River Generator transforms time-series datasets into dynamic flow visualizations that illustrate the ebb and flow of categorical data across temporal dimensions. This tool processes structured input containing timestamps, categorical classifications, and quantitative values to generate layered, proportional area charts where each category's intensity is represented by vertical width and color gradient. The algorithm employs time-series aggregation to bin data into configurable intervals (daily, monthly, etc.), normalizes values against the maximum data point for proportional scaling, and applies cubic spline interpolation to smooth transitions between data points. Underlying SVG rendering leverages ECharts-based browser chart rendering force-directed layout to create continuous, flowing bands that visually communicate dominance shifts between categories over time. Designed for researchers, data journalists, and business analysts, this tool excels at revealing hidden patterns in complex datasets such as tracking social media sentiment shifts during political campaigns, monitoring financial market sector dominance, analyzing environmental variable interactions, or mapping historical event frequency correlations. The generator supports advanced customization through adjustable time binning resolution, Gaussian smoothing parameters, and diverging color scales that enhance perceptual differentiation of overlapping data streams.
usage_steps: 1. Upload CSV/TSV data with timestamp, category, and numeric value columns using the drag-and-drop file zone
2. Map data fields to chart axes using the schema mapping dropdowns (timestamp, category, magnitude)
3. Configure time interval binning with the granularity selector (15-minute increments to annual bins)
4. Adjust Gaussian blur intensity via slider to control data smoothing across adjacent intervals
5. Customize category color ramps using the CIELAB color picker with perceptual uniformity optimization
6. Export interactive SVG visualization with embedded time-axis scrubber for web integration
usage_examples: Visualizing hourly Twitter hashtag volume trends during product launches to identify viral marketing peaks
Comparing quarterly revenue contributions from different business segments over five fiscal years
Mapping daily sensor readings of PM2.5, NO2, and SO2 pollutants during urban air quality studies
Analyzing monthly frequency of historical military engagements across geographic regions from 1800-2000
